title: RELOCATED, MOVED OR RAISED BUILDINGS
officialText:
606.1 Scope. Provisions for relocated, moved or raised buildings shall apply to relocated, moved
or raised buildings as defined in Chapter 2.
606.2 Application. Relocated, moved or raised buildings shall comply with the provisions of
Chapter 14 and, as applicable, with the provisions of Chapters 3 and 7.
